commits.subject: docs(messaging): add Evolution API provider plan
docs(governance): record Phase 06 plan human approval

delivered_scope: Organization-scoped transactional Messaging aggregate with immutable source, customer, destination, template, permission, parameter, and provider snapshots

canonical pending, queued, sending, sent, delivered, failed, cancelled, and uncertain lifecycle with separate history, idempotent command receipts, leases, optimistic version checks, and pessimistic locks
manual sends for active members and manager-tier connection, channel, template, automation-rule, preference, cancellation, and reconciliation commands
closed and versioned WhatsApp and e-mail templates with server-side parameter rendering and explicit purpose/source compatibility
automatic consumption of approved Order, Fulfillment, and Payment outbox events with exact source-version validation and persistent consumption receipts
Evolution API v2.3.7 linked-device, WhatsApp Cloud official-template, and Amazon SES offline request contracts behind adapters with all external effects disabled
fail-closed permission evidence, Customer/contact/source revalidation immediately before dispatch, no silent merge repointing, and active checkout-link revalidation
ambiguous transport handling without blind retry, provider acceptance, delivery evidence, late-failure inconsistency preservation, and explicit reconciliation

callback size, identifier, replay, rate-limit, and secret-channel controls; Evolution callback remains unavailable until its secret resolver is provisioned and Meta/SES callbacks remain blocked pending approved authenticity implementations
masked OPERATOR presentation, manager-tier complete evidence, read-only tenant-scoped admin, Celery default/integrations topology, and clone-continuity documentation

tests.skip_reason: The five governance-baseline tests require .git metadata, which is intentionally absent from the test image; they run in GitHub Actions with the repository checkout.

organization_isolation.evidence: Organization-explicit services, selectors, workers, callbacks, admin, commands, source resolution, provider connections, channels, templates, rules, preferences, messages, attempts, and receipts; active Membership policies and direct cross-tenant tests fail closed.

provider_contracts.evolution_api: Versioned offline Send Text fixture and deterministic per-Organization/channel instance naming; linked-device effects, pairing, secrets, callbacks, and network remain disabled.
provider_contracts.whatsapp_cloud: Versioned offline official-template payload fixture with locale and ordered parameters; credentials, network, and callback authenticity remain disabled.
provider_contracts.amazon_ses: Versioned offline SendEmail payload fixture; credentials, network, SNS authenticity, and callbacks remain disabled.

legacy_reuse.flowlog_reference: Read-only product-idea audit only at the frozen SHA and allowlisted Messaging paths; no technical linkage or artifact reuse.

deferred: provider credentials, real pairing, sandbox calls, public callback registration, external status queries, production activation, and deploy
approved authenticity implementations for WhatsApp Cloud and Amazon SNS callbacks plus a provisioned secret resolver for Evolution callbacks
marketing campaigns, inbound conversations, chatbot, AI, media, SMS, voice, bulk sends, fallback routing, open/click analytics, and multi-provider failover
Appmax, public API, importers, inventory, fiscal, Dashboard, Coolify, homologation, cutover, and later phases
risks: Evolution linked-device is non-official and operationally less stable than WhatsApp Cloud; the adapter remains isolated and disabled until homologation evidence and a separate activation approval exist.
Callback authenticity is intentionally unavailable rather than approximated where a complete approved provider contract is absent.

Coverage is above the 85% gate; the remediated candidate still requires a new independent Review of dispatch linearization, database immutability, configuration concurrency, transient-event recovery, permission evidence, callback replay, tenant isolation, and external-effect blocking.

remediation.evidence: Final dispatch authorization is linearized under PostgreSQL locks; used templates and Message snapshots have ORM and database guards; automation rules use complete idempotency hashes, expected_version, monotonic versions, and concurrency locks; transient event-consumer failures remain retryable; direct PostgreSQL regressions cover every Review 01 finding. Independent Review has not yet accepted these claims.

human_approval.evidence: Remediated implementation candidate only; a new independent Review, QA/Security, and final human approval have not occurred.
